product.name: PhotoTrackly
product.category: Prelaunch B2B real estate photography and property-media operations software
product.oneLine: A planned job-centred workspace for real estate media studios coordinating shoots, photographers, editors, human review and client delivery.

rules.proofForPublished: Exact third-party public listing URL, independently checked

opportunities.name: Photography for Real Estate (PFRE) — vendor directory
opportunities.fit: High: relevant real-estate photography software buyers
opportunities.requirements: Public form requests 300x300 logo, named contact, email, mobile, website and <=225-character description; publisher acceptance not established.
opportunities.action: Prepare correct prelaunch description; owner must decide if a prelaunch company is eligible and submit through publisher form. Do not impersonate business or auto-submit.

opportunities.name: PFRE — editorial article contributions
opportunities.fit: High: workflow checklists for professional photographers
opportunities.requirements: Publisher advertises Submit Your Article; editorial acceptance and topic standards not independently confirmed.
opportunities.action: Offer genuinely useful original handoff checklist if submission later authorized; no unsolicited pitching or copied vendor material.

opportunities.name: BetaList — early-stage startup discovery
opportunities.fit: Moderate: early adopters, less concentrated in real-estate media
opportunities.requirements: Official criteria allow unreleased technology startups with owned domains and signup, but all submissions are paid. No fee authorized.
opportunities.action: Do not pay or submit. Optional after explicit owner approval and verified canonical production signup.

opportunities.name: Product Hunt — photo and video software discovery
opportunities.fit: Moderate: broad software audience; prelaunch product status must be transparent
opportunities.requirements: Product/category pages exist. A legitimate product listing and its prelaunch acceptance rules have not been verified from an authorized account.
opportunities.action: Do not create account, post launch or submit until owner confirms readiness and access.

opportunities.name: PropMedia Podcast — real-estate media business
opportunities.fit: High audience relevance, but not a self-service directory
opportunities.requirements: Editorial/host decision, independent standards and permission; no guest arrangement implied.
opportunities.action: Consider an independent operational example if editor invites contributions; do not contact hosts under no-outreach instruction.

opportunities.name: Professional Photographers of America — Marketplace
opportunities.fit: Relevant professional photographers, but paid advertising rather than earned authority
opportunities.requirements: Listings are PPA-reviewed advertising placements. Requires provider/editor review and cost discussion.
opportunities.action: Defer; no spend authorization or reviewed live product.

opportunities.name: Real Estate Photographers of America — member directory
opportunities.fit: Audience is photographers, but directory is for full-time professional photographers, not software vendors
opportunities.requirements: Membership requires professional photography portfolio and references.
opportunities.action: Exclude; do not misrepresent PhotoTrackly as a professional photography studio.

evidenceSummary.claimScope: No third-party PhotoTrackly endorsement was independently verified in the scoped lookup; not proof of universal absence.
